_comment_file: Azure Function binding configuration for recordh endpoint
_comment_security: Manual Entra ID token validation in run.ps1 provides authentication. authLevel=anonymous bypasses Azure Functions built-in auth for fine-grained control.

bindings._comment_trigger: HTTP POST endpoint for SharePoint site creation
bindings._comment_authLevel: Set to 'anonymous' because manual JWT token validation is performed in run.ps1. This allows fine-grained control over Entra ID authentication including OBO flows. All requests are validated before processing.
bindings.name: Request
bindings._comment_methods: All methods accepted at binding level. Method validation with friendly error messages is performed in run.ps1.
bindings._comment_route: Accessible at /api/recordh (routePrefix defined in host.json). No route parameters.

bindings._comment_output: HTTP response binding for returning results to caller
bindings.name: Response

_security_notes.authentication: Manual Entra ID JWT token validation required (see Test-EntraToken function)
_security_notes.token_validation: Validates audience, tenant, expiration, and required permissions
_security_notes.obo_support: Supports On-Behalf-Of flow for delegated access scenarios
_security_notes.rate_limiting: Consider implementing rate limiting via Azure API Management
_security_notes.monitoring: All requests logged to Application Insights for security monitoring
